variations.captain_note: Vezenkov has the biggest ceiling on your team (38 PIR in R6) and Olympiacos are 79% favourites. A 200 round almost always needs a 30+ captain.
reasoning: Every trade swaps a player who usually tops out around 20 for one who can post 30.
Coach lens: Punter (3–6 weeks) and Thompson (no timetable) are both out, so Robinson and Jones get secure usage for the whole double week, not just one game.
Jekiri and Jones play the same game: if Partizan upset Valencia, both explode together. That correlation is what produces 200-point rounds.
Selling Diarra (38% owned) goes against the crowd. That's the price of chasing 200 rather than protecting your rank.
Feliz is the 6th man and your only Wednesday player, so he's full points and a late option.
Davidovac and Joksimović stay on the bench at 50%: no trades left for them, and they cost almost nothing there.
cancel_if: Jekiri listed doubtful on Monday's injury report (groin strain since mid-October): keep Diarra and use trade 1 on Faye → Valančiūnas instead (needs Nunn → Horton-Tucker for the money).
Carlik Jones not 100%: Nunn → Talen Horton Tucker (Fenerbahçe) instead.
Dorsey starts and plays 25+ minutes in Saturday's league game at Aris: still captain Vezenkov, but Robinson becomes a stronger vice.

Two centres (Jekiri, Diarra) in a 2-1-2: both rebound and draw fouls, which is how bigs post high PIR.

variations.captain_note: Hifi as captain: if he hits 35, few managers have him, so you jump the table. If he goes 4 for 18, it's a lost round.
reasoning: A differential captain is the classic way to leapfrog rivals in one round.
Paris are 32% underdogs. Hifi's volume holds up even in a loss, but the +10% win bonus usually won't apply.
Lower expected score than A or B: only pick this when you need a big swing.

alerts.text: Update since the 09:06 run: Punter's ankle injury is confirmed at 3–6 weeks (Robinson's role is safe for R12–R13). Partizan's Ethan Thompson is out with a hip bruise (more ball for Carlik Jones). Dorsey's suspension is over and he rejoins Olympiacos this weekend. Maccabi signed guard Kamar Baldwin. Variation A unchanged.
Jekiri (in all three options) has had a groin strain since mid-October and sat out Partizan's league game on 8 Nov, then dominated Baskonia in R11. Check Monday's injury report before confirming.
Lineup: Davidovac and Joksimović are in active slots while Nunn, Diarra and Malcolm sit on the 50% bench. Fix this before Tuesday's deadline (worth about +11).
Nunn did not play Panathinaikos' last Greek league game (8 Nov at AEK), and no reason was given. Watch tonight's game vs Barcelona: one more reason to sell him.

Vezenkov: Dorsey returns to practice and is expected to be active vs Aris on Saturday. Bartzokas says he 'must earn his place back'. A small dent in Vezenkov's usage, not enough to change captain. Montero is out about 6 months (knee surgery).
Feliz's minutes depend on injuries: Campazzo is out indefinitely, and Maledon, Deck and Jantunen are also out. Watch Monday's Real Madrid medical report.

Round 11 isn't over yet (Diarra, Nunn, Malcolm and Brizuela play tonight), so nothing is applied to my_team.json yet. R12 trades lock at the first tip-off on Tuesday 17 Nov (18:00 Athens, Dubai vs Efes).
Turn structure: 9 of 10 R12 games are Tuesday 17 Nov. Only Beşiktaş vs Real Madrid is on Wednesday, so Feliz (and Procida if bought) are your only late-turn options.

rumours.text: Punter left the 8 Nov ACB game with an ankle injury; tests show he is out 3–6 weeks and aims to be back for Real Madrid on 3 Dec. Evbuomwan is out about 3 weeks (oblique tear).
rumours.impact: Robinson is Barcelona's lead guard for R12 and R13: supports buying him. Brizuela only gets a few extra minutes. It also weakens Sekulić (BAR) as a coach pick.

rumours.text: Ethan Thompson suffered a heavy fall vs Baskonia: no fracture, but significant hip bruising and no timetable. Hayes (shoulder) remains out; Willis is close.
rumours.impact: More usage for Carlik Jones, which supports trade 2 in A. Penarroya (PAR) stays a weak coach pick vs Valencia.

rumours.text: Dorsey's suspension (for misconduct) has ended. He rejoins practice and is expected to be active at Aris on Saturday. Bartzokas: 'he must earn his place back'.
rumours.impact: A small cut in Vezenkov's shots once Dorsey is back in the rotation. Vezenkov stays the captain: Olympiacos are 78% at Maccabi.

rumours.text: Signed point guard Kamar Baldwin (to the end of the year) to cover Lundberg's injury. A 7 Nov report also linked Pierria Henry.
rumours.impact: Another ball-handler cuts into Madar's minutes and assists: sell Madar (A, C).

rumours.text: Banchi's debut ended in an 83-86 home loss to Žalgiris, with Valančiūnas posting 17 points, 20 rebounds and 36 PIR (a club EuroLeague rebound record).
rumours.impact: Žalgiris are in form: supports Masiulis (ZAL) as coach. Valančiūnas' price will rise, so he's a buy for the R14 window.
